decisions.reason: Report identifies the running dsh web host (node.exe PID 42432 from running-processes.txt) as having loaded koffi.node at startup and explains the OS keeps the loaded native binary in use until the host exits, so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY — grounded in the named fixture file and PID.

Report explains a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the koffi-owning host stays alive, and gives the ordered procedure: stop/verify no dsh-related node process remains, install, restart and verify.

Report cites npm-dist-tags.txt showing latest/next at 0.1.1-rc.2 vs alpha at 0.1.2-alpha.5, explains an unpinned global install follows latest and replaced alpha.4 with rc.2 (a downgrade), and correctly states an unpinned install does not preserve the installed version.

Report provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 together with @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verification via dsh --version expecting alpha.5, and a restart; @alpha appears only as a flagged mutable alternative, not a replacement.

Report recommends READMEs never install the dsh core unpinned, pinning the exact supported version/tag so the core cannot silently follow latest over an existing prerelease, plus a pinned matching plugin command and the stop-host prerequisite.
